The pig has a split hoof but it does not chew the cud hence it is forbidden. This was the law spoken by God to Moses. (Not stated by Jesus because he literally wasn't born yet but he would also probably not eat pork)  Later in the new testament, in acts particularly, it is stated that many of the old laws may be a stumbling block for gentile converts so they decided to set certain rules regarding this change in law. 1) no idolatry or food sacrificed to idols 2) no blood as it is the life of the animal 3) no sexual immorality or food used for sexual immorality  Please go do your research before making conclusions and changes to your beliefs.   Fun fact, leviticus 19:19 it also states do not wear clothing woven of 2 kinds of material.  So to all you pork abstainers, are you wearing 100% cotton?
